# Code Review

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:CodeReview`](gmeow-CodeReview.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/CodeReview>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/software`](../../slices/software.md)

The event of reviewing code changes for quality, correctness, and policy compliance — an event (not an [`Activity`](gmeow-Activity.md), because reviewing is observation-like) with a reviewer, a merge request or commit under review, and an outcome. Distinct from [`gmeow:Review`](gmeow-Review.md), which is the [`InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md) artifact produced by the review. The event type is [`gmeow:eventTypeCodeReview`](../individuals/gmeow-eventTypeCodeReview.md).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Event`](gmeow-Event.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:CodeReview`](gmeow-CodeReview.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Event`](gmeow-Event.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
